packageRules.description: mCaptcha 0.5 and 0.6 expose sha2 0.10 Sha256 in their dev::score API; sha2 0.11's distinct digest types cannot be supplied until upstream changes

Upstream mcaptcha_pow_sha256 0.6 uses wincode 0.4 directly; serde-wincode 0.1.2 broadens its wincode range and can resolve 0.6, causing incompatible SchemaWrite traits. Keep official reference on known-consistent serde-wincode 0.1.0 until upstream fixes bound.
The official mCaptcha 0.6 crate requires the wincode 0.4 SchemaWrite ABI. Do not independently bump this reference harness to the incompatible wincode 0.6 API.
